messages:
nora_cs: Quick sync — HarvestAI renewal in 2 weeks. They reported onboarding latency blips and asked about credits. Need an evidence bundle (uptime, latency by route, incident timeline), a recommended credit amount, and suggested customer comms. I can own the customer-facing note.

sam_eng: On it. Will pull 90d metrics from Console and the route-level traces. Do we want p95 or p99 for the ask?

nora_cs: p95 for interactive endpoints, p99 for batch/ingest. Customer quoted p95 failures as their concern.

ashley_se: I can list onboarding tasks still open — we had a KV cache mismatch on their long prompts and a couple of model-pin rollbacks. I'll add notes about mitigation steps we ran.

leo_am: FYI contract has a soft renewal clause — anything >1% SLA credit triggers review. We should keep recommended credits conservative and with clear evidence.

sam_eng: pulling raw now. Quick query I run in Console: 
```
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95_ms, avg(uptime) as uptime_pct
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE customer_id = 'harvestai' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY route;
```
Will paste table once done.

deploy-bot: New SLO dashboard snapshot generated for harvestai at 2026-02-28T18:02:11Z — https://console.redwood.ai/slo/harvestai/snapshot/2026-02-28

mia_cs: I'll prep the comms draft once we have numbers. Suggested tone: acknowledge, show timeline + root cause (KV cache + model variant), list remediation and credits calc, offer dedicated runbook session.

claire_sre: From infra side — we saw a brief autoscaler delay after a config change on 2026-01-09 that correlates with one of the blips. I can add the incident notes and the mitigation we applied (fixed scaler thresholds + warm pool).

sam_eng: Pasted short summary: route "chat.interactive" p95 = 312ms (target 200ms) uptime = 99.78% (target 99.9%). route "ingest.bulk" p99 = 1.2s (target 2s) uptime = 99.99%. Most customer-visible regression is chat.interactive.

ashley_se: Thanks. I'll attach the onboarding checklist and mark the KV cache step + model pinning notes. We completed a partial rollback on 2026-01-10.

nora_cs: Good. leo — given chat.interactive missed p95 by ~112ms and uptime shortfall 0.12% over 90d, what credit range are you comfortable recommending?

leo_am: Propose we offer a 0.5% invoice credit (midpoint) with a path to waive if we run a dedicated optimization session and hit targets for 30 days. Makes it proactive.

billing-bot: Draft credit calc: 0.5% of monthly committed spend = $X (estimate computed from last invoice). I can attach final numbers when we confirm the committed spend line item.

mia_cs: I'll draft customer note: 
- Acknowledge issue + incident timeline;
- Attach SLO snapshot + route-level table;
- Offer 0.5% credit + free 1hr enablement session;
- Ask to confirm if they'd like a technical deep dive or immediate remediation.

claire_sre: Recommend including the postmortem link and what we changed in infra config (scaler thresholds, warm pool). That helps show lasting fixes.

nora_cs: Action items:
- sam_eng: paste full Console tables & traces (ETA 2h)
- claire_sre: paste incident notes + infra changes (ETA today EOD)
- ashley_se: onboarding checklist + mitigations (ETA EOD)
- leo_am: recommended credit text for contract (ETA EOD)
- mia_cs: comms draft (will iterate after numbers)

sam_eng: noted — will drop CSV + Console links here.

ashley_se: noted, will include the exact rollback commit and customer-visible timestamps.

leo_am: will draft the legal-safe credit wording and share for review.

nora_cs: thanks all. I'll assemble the bundle and run a quick review with legal if needed before sending. If anyone else wants visibility, ping me. :thumbsup:

mia_cs: tagging the renewal playbook: @nora_cs please add the bundle to /playbooks/renewal_evidence/harvestai so CS Ops can file it for QBRs.

nora_cs: done — added files and final note once we have numbers.

sam_eng: link to tables: https://console.redwood.ai/exports/harvestai/90d-slo.csv

deploy-bot: Snapshot archived to /evidence/harvestai/2026-02-28-ops-snapshot.tar.gz

nora_cs: Closing loop — I'll push the customer note by EOD tomorrow after Leo and Sam's numbers. Thanks everyone.
